onboarding.data_source.realty_help_title: Where to find Krisha.kz User ID?
onboarding.data_source.realty_help_text: Go to your personal account on Krisha.kz or open any of your listings. The profile URL contains your ID (e.g. 12345678).
onboarding.data_source.auto_sales_help_t: Where to find Kolesa.kz Seller ID?
Go to your seller/dealership account on Kolesa.kz or open your dealership listing. Copy the ID or full URL.
onboarding.data_source.auto_service_labe: 2GIS / Instagram Profile or Service Price List URL
onboarding.data_source.auto_service_help: Provide a link to your 2GIS page, Instagram profile, or price list URL. AI will configure service qualification and appointment booking.
